strings.lang.intro: Mitauro mikuru yakagara yaiswa. Dhaunhoudha mutauro wako kuti uwane shanduro yakakwana pasina neti — tsananguro, ngano uye zvimwe.

strings.settings.location.cityNone: Hazvina kuwanikwa — rondedzero iri mukati ine maguta makuru anosvika 5,300, saka maguta madiki anoshaikwa.
strings.settings.location.cityNearest: Sarudza guta guru rakapfupi: mukati me~50 km denga rinoita rakafanana.

strings.pro.freeCore: Chikamu chikuru chichagara chiri mahara nekusingaperi — kamera, Zuva, Mwedzi nemapuraneti ese 7. Pro inowedzera chete rondedzero uye inowedzera zvimwe zviridzwa.
strings.pro.lifetimeDesc: Kutenga kamwe. Pasina nguva yekuguma — hazvimboperi kana kuvandudzwa.
strings.settings.speech.desc: Inoverenga chinangwa nekutungamirira nenzwi — kushandisa pasina maoko uye vanorema maziso.
strings.settings.fov.desc: Gadzirisa zvishoma kuti mitsetse yemapoka enyenyedzi nenzira dze-satellite zifanane denenga rechokwadi.

strings.tonight.issNone: Hapana kupfuura kweISS kunooneka mumazuva gumi anotevera
strings.tonight.noNight: Panguva ino yegore hapana husiku chaihwo pano
strings.ev.equinoxSub: Masikati neusiku zvinenge zvakaenzana — zuva rinobuda chaipo kumabvazuva uye rinonyura chaipo kumavirira
strings.ev.supermoonSub: Mwedzi wakazara uri pedyo zvikuru pagore — wakati kurei uye unopenya zvishoma kupfuura zvakajairwa
strings.ev.blueMoonSub: Mwedzi wakazara wechipiri mumwedzi uno — izita chete, haisi bhuruu chaiyo
strings.ev.oppositionSub: Iri pedyo zvikuru uye inopenya zvikuru — inooneka usiku hwose, yakatarisana nezuva
strings.ev.oppositionSubFaint: Iri mudenga usiku hwose, asi yakaneta zvakanyanya kuziso — nongedza mabhainokura kwainongedzera app
strings.ev.elongationEvening: Inooneka zvakanaka pasi kumavirira mushure mekunyura kwezuva · {deg}° kubva kuzuva
strings.ev.elongationMorning: Inooneka zvakanaka pasi kumabvazuva zuva risati rabuda · {deg}° kubva kuzuva
strings.settings.identifyLines.desc: Inodhirowa mitsetse inobatanidza nyeredzi dzeboka rimwe nerimwe riri pakuonekwa. Unogona kuzvibatanidza nekuzvidzima mu "Ndechipi icho?" nebhatani re 👁.
strings.sat.desc.iss: Chivakwa chikuru chinogarwa nevanhu mumuchadenga. Chikwata chevaenzi vemuchadenga chinogaramo nguva dzose, uye chinotenderera Pasi mukati memaminitsi 92 oga oga. Kazhinji ndicho chinhu chinopenya kupfuura zvese chinoyambuka denga usiku.
strings.sat.desc.css: Chiteshi chemuchadenga cheChina, chagarwa kubvira 2021. Chidiki kupfuura Chiteshi Chemuchadenga Chepasi Rose, asi pakupfuura zvakanaka chinopenya zvakafanana.
strings.sat.desc.hst: Tererosikopu yemuchadenga yakatumirwa muna 1990 iyo yakashandura zvatinoziva nezve nyika yose. Yakatora mifananidzo yemapoka enyeredzi ari kure kure uye yakabatsira kuongorora kukura kwenyika yose.
strings.sat.desc.acs3: Satellite yekuedza yeNASA ine seyili yezuva rinosvika ma80 m², rinosundwa chete nesimba rechiedza chezuva. Seyili rinopenya rinoita kuti ipenye zvakanyanya kuenzana nehukuru hwayo.
strings.sat.desc.envisat: Satellite yeEurope yekuongorora Pasi, ine hukuru hwebhazi. Kukurukurirana nayo kwakarasika muna 2012, uye kubvira ipapo yakaramba iri mukutenderera seimwe yezvinhu zvikuru zvemarara emuchadenga.
strings.sat.desc.amos: Satellite dzekukurukurirana dzeIsrael. Dziri pakakwirira kwemakm 36,000, saka dzinoratidzika dzisingachinji panzvimbo imwechete yedenga. Hadzioneki nemeso chete, asi app inoratidza kwadziri.
strings.sat.desc.eros: Satellite yeIsrael yekutora mifananidzo yakanaka yakachengetwa neImageSat, yakatumirwa muna 2022.
strings.sat.desc.venus: Satellite yeIsrael-France yekutsvakurudza yakatumirwa muna 2017 iyo yakatora mifananidzo yemiti neminda yekurima kuongorora shanduko dzenzvimbo.
strings.sat.desc.cat.weather: Satellite yemamiriro ekunze inopfuura pamusoro pemapoli. Inotora mifananidzo yemakore, mhepo dzine simba, netembiricha, uye ruzivo rwayo rwunobatsira kufungidzira mamiriro ekunze.
strings.sat.desc.cat.observation: Satellite inotora mifananidzo yepamusoro pePasi — masango, maguta, makungwa, nechando — kuti ionese kushanduka kwazvo nenguva.
strings.sat.desc.cat.science: Satellite yakavakwa kuongorora muchadenga kana Pasi. Dzimwe dzadzo hadzisi kushanda, asi dzichiri mukutenderera.
strings.sat.desc.cat.telescope: Tererosikopu yemuchadenga inoongorora nyika yose kubva pamusoro pemhepo, inomedza chiedza chakawanda chinobva kumuchadenga.
strings.sat.desc.cat.communication: Satellite inofambisa terevhizheni, indaneti, nemafoni. Dzakawanda dzinobhururuka kure kure, saka dzishoma chete dzinoonekwa nemeso chete.
strings.sat.desc.cat.starlink: Imwe yezviuru zveSatellite dzeStarlink dzeSpaceX, dzinopa indaneti kubva kumuchadenga. Dzinobhururuka pasi, saka dzinoonekwa nyore, uye dzimwe nguva dzinopfuura mumutsetse murefu, imwe nemumwe.
strings.sat.desc.cat.rocket: Chikamu chepamusoro cherokiti, chakaenda neSatellite kukutenderera kwayo uye ikasara ipapo. Zvinhu izvi zvikuru uye zvakawanda zvinopenya, saka zvinonyatsoonekwa.
strings.identify.proMore: Pro inozivisazve nyeredzi, mapoka enyeredzi, nezvinhu zvemuchadenga zvakadzika zvose.
strings.tonight.hint: Nguva dzinenge chinhu chimwe nechimwe chiri pamusoro pehorizoni manheru ano · dzvanya kuti utarise kamera kwazviri
